title: Sewing
text: “The preparations for the traveling trade are progressing steadily. Once we get a wagon, things should really start to take off… For now, I’m making potions using my Shield skill, but if I’m going to make them from scratch, I might need some tools.”
“Items made using skills have consistent quality, you see. If you want to make high-quality items, it’s better to make them yourself.”
After the envoy from Siltvelt left, I continued discussing the traveling trade with my Father.
“Well, as long as it sells, I guess anything will do…”
“It’s not impossible to make weapons and armor, you know.”
“Really?”
“I do remember my future Father saying, though, that we’d need to get the recipes first, and we’d have to consider production costs, customers’ budgets, and what they actually want.”

I remember us talking about selling the weapons Ren made while traveling as merchants. However, it seems items like these aren’t the sort of things that sell well through peddling. I recall that he used to deliver them to the weapons shop in the neighboring town to be sold there.
“So, aside from medicine, what else was selling?”
“Hmm… I believe he was selling food.”
“Like turning meat and vegetables into preserved foods to sell?”
“Well, in my future Father’s territory, there were plants that bore edible crops almost immediately.”
“Wow… That’s so typical of another world. There were things that convenient?”
“Boo?”
“That’s right. Keel cherished something called the ‘crepe tree’ very much.”
“What’s that…? Is it like a bread tree? Either way, that’s pretty amazing.”
“Bububu?”
“Crepes don’t exist in this world? Um, ‘crepe’ is the name of a dessert in our world—”
Father is telling Keel about crepes. It would be quickest to see the real thing, but we don’t have the ingredients.
“Father also used to make good use of plants that turn into houses.”
“Motoyasu, do you remember where he got those handy plants?”
“Hmm… I feel like I might have an idea, but I’m not entirely sure.”
“No… which is it?”

Back when I was wandering the world, unaware that I’d been deceived by the Crimson Swine and unable to accept the fact that I’d lost to the Spirit Tortoise, I heard that my Father had resolved a plant-related disaster caused by the Spear Hero in a village southwest of Melromarc. In the game, they said that incident resolved the famine… but I suppose there must have been some underlying issue.

The game knowledge I possessed was only useful from one perspective in this world. That goes for weapon enhancement methods, other events… and the Spirit Tortoise as well. Given that, I can’t say I have no idea where to find it.
“It’s not that I don’t have any ideas, but it’s still just speculation.”
“Right… Well, if we have time to spare, why not go look for it?”
“True. After all, my future Father said it could be dangerous if used incorrectly.”
“Hmm… Well, we’ll have to be careful then. Should we head out soon?”
We left the tavern and set off with Yuki-chan and the others. Yuki-chan and Kou will transform into angels sometime tonight. That means we’ll need to get some new clothes for them.
“Motoyasu-kun, what are your plans after this?”
“Since Yuki-chan and the others will be able to transform into angels, I’m going to gather the materials to make some clothes.”

Come to think of it… the Monster Merchant had placed an order for that, hadn’t they? If that’s the case, maybe I should go ask them again? Otherwise, Yuki-chan and the others will end up spending the night naked.
“Making clothes, huh… It’s amazing that you can even make clothes, Motoyasu-kun.”
“It’s nothing compared to Father’s cooking skills.”
“It’s not like I’m that good at it, though…”

He’s still as good at being modest as ever. That’s right. There’s also the option for Father to go on a traveling sales trip as a cook. Well, putting that aside… I seem to recall that Keel also wore a costume when he was traveling as a merchant.
“I’ll make Keel’s clothes while I’m at it. Father, could you let me know Keel’s measurements later?”
“Huh? Well… sure.”
If you’re not sure about the measurements, just have Father take them—that should be fine.
“Bub!?”
“Huh? Didn’t I mention it? Keel’s going to take my place selling goods from the carriage.”
“Bububububub!”
Keel is shaking his head as if to say he doesn’t want to do it.
“It’ll be fine. Keel isn’t the type to get intimidated, and it’s just a simple job of selling things in my place… If you get stuck, just ask me—I’ll teach you the tricks, so don’t worry.”
“Bubub…”
Keel is nodding, looking rather reluctant. Yuki-chan and the others’ stomachs are growling loudly.
“If Motoyasu-kun is going to make the clothes, we’ll need to buy the fabric somewhere.”
“Yuki-chan and the others’ clothes must be made from a special material, you see.”
“Is that so?”
“Since Yuki-chan and the others can transform, their clothes need to change shape accordingly when they transform.”
“So there’s a mysterious fabric, huh? Do you know how to make it?”

“Yes. First, we need equipment that converts Magical Power into thread—the kind used by Demi-Humans who can transform into Beastmen. It takes a lengthy process to turn that thread into fabric before it can finally be made into clothes.”
“That sounds like it would cost quite a bit…”
“It’s not a problem.”

Come to think of it, we could easily get it if we went to Siltvelt. That’s where it all comes from, after all. Tonight, let’s take Yuki-chan and the others to a shop in Siltvelt that specializes in this and have them spin the thread for us.
“Do you want to have your clothes made the same way, Keel-kun?”
“Bubububu!”

Keel is shaking his head from side to side as if he’s reluctant. He’s still growing, after all—wouldn’t it be a problem if his clothes had to be resized? Oh? Come to think of it, since Filolial-sama and the others don’t grow beyond their established appearances, I’ve never heard of Magical Power-made clothes becoming too small and no longer fitting.
“Keel is still growing, after all. I think it’s better to make his clothes out of regular fabric for now.”
“Got it. Well then, I’ll leave it to you, Motoyasu-kun.”
“You’ve entrusted it to me.”

Since I made clothes that suited Yuki-chan and the others last time, I’ll easily whip up a maid outfit for Keel to wear while working—it’ll serve as practice, too. With that, we stopped by the Tailor’s shop in Melromarc, took Keel’s measurements, bought some fabric, and set off from the castle town. I rode on Yuki-chan’s back, with Kou following behind us. My Father was riding on Sakura-chan’s back alongside Keel.
“Well then, see you later.”
“See you later.”

An envoy from Siltvelt will issue a commercial pass within a few days, so until then, I should arrange for a carriage or something similar. What kind of carriage should I prepare? After all, we’ll need to earn time by peddling for over two months…

Since Filolial-sama and the others are strong, even a sturdy, heavy carriage wouldn’t be a problem. However, comfort is important, too. So that my Father and the others can get used to traveling by carriage… would a regular carriage be fine?
I think it would be a hassle if we couldn’t even hunt bandits. With that in mind, I rode Yuki-chan to move quickly and staved off Yuki-chan and the others’ hunger by hunting monsters along the way.
“Well then…”
I booked a room early and made a outfit for Keel in the inn’s stable where Yuki-chan and the others were staying.
“Quest?”
Yuki-chan and Kou are picking up the scraps of fabric I discarded and playing around together. It’s a heartwarming sight.
“It’s about time.”
I gazed at Yuki-chan and Kou as they played and made my request.
“Filolial-sama, please take on your angelic forms.”

Yuki-chan and Kou began to transform into angels, emitting a soft glow. Their appearances were exactly as I’d seen them in the previous playthrough. Yuki-chan is an angel with white hair that almost looks silver. She exudes a sense of nobility. Kou has yellow hair and looks a bit mischievous.
“Motoyasu-sama—”
“Kitamura! Let’s play!”
“Well then… first, I’d like you to put on the temporary nightgowns I’ve prepared.”
“Got it!”
“Okay!”
“Please be careful—they’ll tear when you transform.”
It’s not late yet, so even if I take Yuki-chan and the others through the portal, it’d be better to go back to my room at the inn and pretend to be asleep first.
“So, what shall we play?”
“Um… give me a piggyback ride!”
“Sure thing.”
“Ah, that’s not fair—you’re only doing it for Kou!”
“I’ll give Yuki-chan one, too.”
And so, I kept them entertained until late into the night.
